content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Github pages

GitHub Pages is a powerful hosting solution for digital products that eliminates reliance on traditional payment processors. By utilizing GitHub Pages, creators can host their online stores for free while maintaining complete control over their products and sales data. This approach is particularly significant for those in countries where payment platforms are restricted, allowing creators to bypass high fees and achieve financial independence. With the right architecture, your digital store can operate with minimal overhead, maximizing your earnings and ensuring you keep more of what you sell.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture behind using GitHub Pages for a digital product store is straightforward yet effective. It combines GitHub Pages for hosting your storefront, Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers for backend logic, and NOWPayments for handling cryptocurrency payments. This stack enables automatic delivery of digital products upon payment confirmation, ensuring a seamless user experience. Each component serves a specific purpose: GitHub Pages delivers a fast, static site; NOWPayments facilitates instant crypto transactions; and the backend manages order processing and fulfillment. This architecture is robust, allowing for scalability as your sales grow.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This approach is designed for digital creators who sell ebooks, courses, templates, and other digital products but lack access to traditional payment platforms. It empowers entrepreneurs in Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, and similar regions to create fully functional online stores without incurring excessive fees. Unlike Gumroad, which charges 10% on every sale, using NOWPayments only incurs a 0.5% fee, allowing creators to retain more of their revenue. By choosing this architecture, creators gain independence from restrictive platforms and can scale their businesses sustainably.
Retain 92% more revenue by avoiding high platform fees with NOWPayments.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The functionality of a GitHub Pages-based store hinges on several key components. First, GitHub Pages provides free hosting for your storefront, allowing you to showcase your products without monthly fees. Second, Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers serve as the backend logic, managing order storage and product delivery. Finally, NOWPayments processes payments in over 300 cryptocurrencies, ensuring you can accept payments without KYC or buyer accounts. Together, these elements create a cohesive infrastructure that operates smoothly and efficiently, allowing creators to focus on product development and marketing rather than technical challenges.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy your GitHub Pages store, start by setting up a GitHub account and creating a new repository for your online store. Next, prepare your product files for upload and configure your GitHub Pages settings for public access. Integrate Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers to handle order processing and product delivery. Finally, set up NOWPayments to manage cryptocurrency transactions, ensuring you can receive payments directly. This process requires minimal technical knowledge and can be completed quickly. For a comprehensive solution, consider the Complete Builder Kit ($197), which includes all the necessary blueprints and templates to streamline your deployment process.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

The fastest path to your first sovereign digital product sale is a three-step process. First, create a NOWPayments account — configure your wallet addresses for USDT on Tron and Bitcoin as starting points, generate your API key, and set the webhook endpoint URL. Second, choose your stack: Stack 01 uses GitHub Pages plus Google Apps Script and takes most creators four to six hours following the Sovereign Blueprint at $47; Stack 02 uses Cloudflare Pages plus Workers plus Supabase and is deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours with the Edge Commerce Stack at $197. Third, upload your product files, set your prices in USD, and run a complete mainnet test transaction before promoting.
Host your digital products for free using GitHub Pages and maintain complete ownership.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

Digital creators selling ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, presets, and beats often reach this infrastructure question after hitting payout restrictions or platform policy problems on Gumroad, Payhip, or Lemon Squeezy. The difference with a sovereign stack is structural: there is no platform relationship to manage, no content policy to comply with, and no payout schedule to wait on. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 deploys the complete infrastructure in 48 hours under your own accounts. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 documents the build process for creators who prefer to self-deploy. Both are available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Begin by creating your GitHub account and repository for your store. Upload your digital product files to the repository. Configure GitHub Pages to serve your site publicly. Set up Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers for backend order management. Integrate NOWPayments for seamless cryptocurrency transactions. Test your store for functionality and ensure product delivery works correctly. Launch your store and start promoting your products.
